title: Mining beam is invisible with default-on HDR
body: SpatialReuseShade.comp CompositeMiningBeams writes only sceneRadianceImage, while the HDR tonemap (ExposureTonemapSystem) reads sceneRadianceHistoryOutput, stored before the composite; with VIXEN_HDR_EXPOSURE on, test_headless_cornell_graph.cpp:313,369 fail (beam frame byte-identical to no-beam). Pre-existing since 3dcdef4f; fixture runs HDR off. Fix: tonemap the composited image or composite into the history (ghosting trade-off). Tier sol: renderer design choice with a temporal trade-off.

title: Wave base reds from the texture runtime extraction
body: On origin/wave/authoring-convergence 13358fe3 (from fd89b971): check-no-new-mutex.sh fails on a stale allowlist row VIXEN/libraries/Textures/src/TextureLoader.cpp (re-sync with --fix), and libraries/CashSystem/tests/test_registration_api fails to link (TextureCacher vtable, relocation in read-only section). Tier haiku: allowlist re-sync plus a link dependency.

title: stb pin cannot be fetched with GIT_SHALLOW
body: VIXEN/dependencies/CMakeLists.txt:33 pins stb to 2c980bb5 with GIT_SHALLOW TRUE; a fresh fetch cache fails configure (fatal: unable to read tree). Workaround: -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_STB=~/.cache/vixen-fetchcontent-cache/stb-src. Fix: drop GIT_SHALLOW for SHA pins or use a tag. Tier haiku: one CMake option.
